title: The reopened D23 comparison in the window unit
body:
Outcome: the reopened D23 comparison runs in the window unit under a preregistered protocol and its result is noted in adr-draft-orchestrator-comparison.md.
Why: The program reads D23 as not discharged: `t-dsxc125` is one A/B on dollars, seconds and lint, and D23 asks for two weeks of full KRN against a plain harness on five measures (`03` §11). Unless the operator vetoes, the comparison reopens in the window unit with paired tasks, at least 20 per arm.
Proof: the protocol is preregistered before results are observed; the note in adr-draft-orchestrator-comparison.md carries the result.
Scope: a protocol under `.krn/`; `adr-draft-orchestrator-comparison.md`.
Order: Wave 4: the protocol for D23's comparison; the note of adr-draft-orchestrator-comparison.md with C3's result.
Program: .krn/runs/krn-architecture-program/05-program.md section 4, slice D23.

Preregistered: .krn/runs/d23-comparison/protocol.md sha256 6d1f45daade45aab0c3f8099a800a9bd01abcb4a174d85a9f9524e02285c0faf (2026-11-10, before any D23 replay and before C3's result). Arm K reuses C3 replays at the adopted model; arm P strips skills, hooks and krn.
